Area of a rectangle of length 15 cm and width 8 cm is:
Find perimeter and area of a square plot of side 14 m.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Perimeter = 4 x 14 = 56 m. Area = 14 x 14 = 196 sq m.

questions.question_text: Find width of a rectangle if Area = 300 sq m and Length = 25 m.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Width = Area / Length = 300 / 25 = 12 m.

questions.question_text: A wire rectangle of length 12 cm and width 8 cm is reshaped into a square. Find the side and area of the square.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Wire length = Perimeter = 2(12 + 8) = 40 cm. Side of square = 40/4 = 10 cm. Area of square = 10^2 = 100 sq cm.

questions.question_text: Explain area conservation when a shape is cut and rearranged into a new configuration.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Cutting and rearranging conserves the total surface space (area remains unchanged), even though the boundary length (perimeter) may change.

questions.question_text:
Case Study: Tiling a Hall Floor. A hall floor is 10 m long and 8 m wide. It is tiled with square tiles of side 50 cm (0.5 m).
(a) Calculate total tiles needed. (2 marks)
(b) Find total cost at Rs 20 per tile. (3 marks)
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
(a) Hall Area = 10 x 8 = 80 sq m. Tile Area = 0.5 x 0.5 = 0.25 sq m. Tiles = 80 / 0.25 = 320 tiles.
(b) Total cost = 320 x 20 = Rs 6400.

questions.question_text: Cost of fencing a square garden of side 20 m at Rs 15 per meter is:
If side of a square is doubled, its area becomes:
Find perimeter of a regular pentagon of side 9 cm.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Perimeter = 5 x 9 = 45 cm.

questions.question_text: Calculate cost of tiling a rectangular plot 500 m long and 200 m wide at Rs 8 per hundred sq m.
A rectangular park is 175 m long and 125 m wide. Find the cost of fencing it at Rs 12 per meter.
Using 9 unit square tiles, arrange them to form (a) minimum perimeter, (b) maximum perimeter.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: (a) Minimum perimeter: 3x3 square array => P = 4(3) = 12 units. (b) Maximum perimeter: 1x9 linear strip => P = 2(1 + 9) = 20 units.

questions.question_text:
Case Study: Carpet for Room. A room is 7 m long and 5 m wide. A square carpet of side 4 m is laid on the floor.
(a) Find area of room floor and area of carpet. (2 marks)
(b) Find area of floor left uncarpeted. (3 marks)
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
(a) Room Area = 7 x 5 = 35 sq m. Carpet Area = 4 x 4 = 16 sq m.
(b) Uncarpeted Area = 35 - 16 = 19 sq m.

questions.question_text: Perimeter of an equilateral triangle of side 12 cm is:
How many sq cm are in 1 sq m?
Find side of a square whose perimeter is 64 cm.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Side = 64 / 4 = 16 cm.

questions.question_text: Area of a square carpet is 81 sq m. Find its perimeter.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Side = sqrt(81) = 9 m. Perimeter = 4 x 9 = 36 m.

questions.question_text: Find perimeter and area of an L-shaped composite figure formed by cutting a 2x2 corner from a 6x6 square.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Original square 6x6. Remaining area = 36 - 4 = 32 sq units. Outer perimeter remains 4 x 6 = 24 units.

questions.question_text: If length of a rectangle is doubled and width is halved, state what happens to its area and perimeter.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: New Area = (2l) x (w/2) = l x w (Area UNCHANGED). New Perimeter = 2(2l + w/2) = 4l + w (Perimeter CHANGES).

questions.question_text:
Case Study: Running Track Boundary. A sports field consists of a central rectangle 100 m long and 50 m wide with two semicircular ends.
(a) Find area of central rectangular field. (2 marks)
(b) Find total fencing cost around the rectangular boundary alone at Rs 25 per meter. (3 marks)
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
(a) Rectangular Area = 100 x 50 = 5000 sq m.
(b) Rectangular perimeter = 2(100 + 50) = 300 m. Cost = 300 x 25 = Rs 7500.

questions.question_text: Perimeter of a regular octagon of side 6 cm is:
Area of a square of side 2.5 m is:
Perimeter of a rectangle is 28 cm and length is 8 cm. Find its breadth.
Find area of a rectangle whose length is 18 cm and diagonal is 30 cm.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: By Pythagoras: Width = sqrt(30^2 - 18^2) = sqrt(900 - 324) = sqrt(576) = 24 cm. Area = 18 x 24 = 432 sq cm.

questions.question_text: A pathway 1 m wide is built around outside of a rectangular garden 20 m long and 15 m wide. Find pathway area.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Outer dimensions = (20+2) x (15+2) = 22 x 17 = 374 sq m. Inner Area = 20 x 15 = 300 sq m. Pathway Area = 374 - 300 = 74 sq m.

questions.question_text: Show that among all rectangles of fixed perimeter 20 cm, the square encloses maximum area.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Perimeter = 20 => l + w = 10. Dimensions (l, w) and Areas: (9,1)->9; (8,2)->16; (7,3)->21; (6,4)->24; (5,5)->25 (Square). Square gives max area 25 sq cm.

questions.question_text:
Case Study: Farmland Division. A farmer owns a square field of side 80 m.
(a) Calculate total area and perimeter of the field. (2 marks)
(b) The farmer divides it into 4 equal smaller square plots. Find side length and area of each plot. (3 marks)
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
(a) Area = 80 x 80 = 6400 sq m. Perimeter = 4 x 80 = 320 m.
(b) 4 equal plots => Side of each plot = 80 / 2 = 40 m. Area of each plot = 40 x 40 = 1600 sq m.

questions.question_text: Area of a rectangle is 96 sq cm and width is 8 cm. Its length is:
Perimeter of an isosceles triangle with equal sides 7 cm and base 5 cm is:
Find side of a square whose area is 225 sq cm.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Side = sqrt(225) = 15 cm.

questions.question_text: Find perimeter of a regular 12-gon (dodecagon) of side 4.5 cm.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Perimeter = 12 x 4.5 = 54 cm.

questions.question_text: A rectangular room floor 6 m x 4 m is paved with rectangular tiles 20 cm x 10 cm. Find total tiles needed.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Floor Area = 600 cm x 400 cm = 240,000 sq cm. Tile Area = 20 x 10 = 200 sq cm. Tiles = 240,000 / 200 = 1200 tiles.

questions.question_text: Compare linear units used for perimeter with square units used for area with suitable examples.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Perimeter measures 1D boundary length using linear units (cm, m). Area measures 2D enclosed surface region using square units (sq cm, sq m). Example: Perimeter = 20 cm, Area = 25 sq cm.

questions.question_text:
Case Study: Playground Paving Cost. A school playground is 120 m long and 80 m wide.
(a) Find cost of leveling playground at Rs 5 per sq m. (2 marks)
(b) Find cost of fencing playground boundary with 3 rounds of wire at Rs 10 per meter. (3 marks)
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
(a) Area = 120 x 80 = 9600 sq m. Leveling cost = 9600 x 5 = Rs 48,000.
(b) Single round perimeter = 2(120 + 80) = 400 m. 3 rounds = 1200 m. Fencing cost = 1200 x 10 = Rs 12,000.
